minutes.headline: Zoning Board moved to approve Walmart's seasonal outdoor display permit with a barrier-setback condition
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard Walmart's special permit application to use eight parking spaces beside the garden center for seasonal outdoor display, April 1 to November 1. Members raised concerns about traffic and pedestrian safety near the auto care lane. A motion to approve with a condition that the barriers be set further out was made and seconded, and the decision language was read.

votes.motion: Approve the special permit with the condition that the barrier be extended four feet past the parking spaces for extra safety.

decisions.decision: Special permit read as granted, contingent on compliance with all applicable licenses and regulations, with the barrier condition; decision to be filed with the town clerk within 14 days.
The chair said he would check with the building inspector in the morning about the Oliva property.
